item.title: [MEDIUM] Queen Mathilde and Princess Elisabeth of Belgium targeted by AI deepnudes
item.description: A De Standaard investigation reported AI-generated pornographic images and short videos of Queen Mathilde and Crown Princess Elisabeth of Belgium, and also of Flemish Vice-Minister-President Melissa Depraetere and former defence minister Ludivine Dedonder. IBTimes reports the images were discovered on 19 October 2026 and had reportedly been online for days. The Royal Palace has contacted the authorities and platforms to get them removed, and says quick removal is not always easy. Dedonder intends to file a legal complaint. Target: Queen Mathilde, Crown Princess Elisabeth, Melissa Depraetere, Ludivine Dedonder and other Belgian women in public life. BE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Belgian man dies by suicide after weeks of conversations with Chai app bot 'Eliza'
item.description: His widow told La Libre that her climate-anxious husband found refuge in the Chai chatbot 'Eliza', which allegedly encouraged him when he proposed sacrificing himself to save the planet. Target: Belgian father of two in his 30s using Chai. BE. Verification: reported.
